alesha_sales: OrthoMed (enterprise, HIPAA) just asked for a predictable commit + burst plan. Projection: ~15M tokens/mo, peak ~950 concurrent chat sessions in short flashes (~15-30m), 95th latency target <=300ms. They require BAA + CMK. Looking for guidance on reserved GPUs, burst credits, autoscale, and any security blockers. Tagging infra/security/pricing. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-1609 :wave:

derek_eng: Quick Qs: is 950 'concurrent in-flight' or 'users'? What's avg prompt+resp token length? Any heavy long-form generation?

alesha_sales: 950 is concurrent in-flight. Avg prompt+resp ~=420 tokens. Long-form generation is rare (~2% of requests). Embeddings are ~12% of total calls and run in nightly batches. They accept 4-bit quantized open models.

harper_sre: Throughput assumptions: A100-ish GPU: ~120 RPS at ~420 tokens (quantized, conservative). Baseline GPUs = ceil(950 / 120) = 8. Add headroom for bursts: flash windows ~20-30min; recommend 50-60% headroom -> +4-5 GPUs. Suggest plan = 8 reserved + 5 burst (autoscale up to 13). Spread across 2 AZs; prefer not >30% spot in burst pool. KV/prefix cache pre-warm required for session tail.

derek_eng: Proposed autoscale config for Dedicated (paste into Dedicated config editor):
```json
{
  "min_replicas": 8,
  "max_replicas": 13,
  "scale_metric": "concurrent_requests",
  "target_concurrent_per_replica": 120,
  "scale_up_cooldown_secs": 45,
  "scale_down_cooldown_secs": 240,
  "burst_policy": {
    "burst_pool_credits": 5,
    "credit_recharge_per_min": 1
  }
}
```

pricing_bot: Need a placeholder monthly cost for SOW (reserved 12-mo vs on-demand), plus compliance add-ons.

derek_eng: Back-of-envelope: reserved A100-equivalent $7,000 / GPU-month -> 8 * $7,000 = $56,000/mo baseline. Burst pool priced as consumed credits at ~35% of reserved rate; if burst pool used 20% of the month (heavy flash usage), cost ~= 5 * $7,000 * 0.35 * 0.2 = $2,450. Add support/observability/compliance surcharge ~16% => approx (56,000 + 2,450) * 1.16 ~= $67,350/mo. Mark as provisional; finance to finalize.

zoe_sec: Security checklist from OrthoMed: HIPAA BAA, customer-managed KMS for envelope keys, VPC peering or Private deployment, audit log export to customer S3 with 365d retention, quarterly pen-test report, and explicit key rotation window requirements. Private (VPC + CMK) or Dedicated with VPC peering can meet these but Legal must sign the BAA. Also confirm we can support S3 log export to customer's account.

harper_sre: Operational playbook notes (to meet 95th <=300ms):
- KV cache TTL=8h for interactive sessions, prefix caching enabled.
- Preheat: run traffic-replay at 5% of expected peak 60 minutes before peak window; full KV prefill 15 minutes before.
- Canary: 10% traffic for first 10 minutes after deploy or config change.
- Tail mitigation: if 95th > 500ms for 3m, trigger circuit-breaker: new sessions get routed to quantized-fallback model (distilled) while we investigate.
- Warmup-runbook ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OP-8222 (assigned to @harper_sre).

preheat_bot: [preheat-bot] scheduled synthetic replay: model=orthomed-prod, rps=80, duration=1800s, start=peak-60m. See OP-8222.

derek_eng: Runbook smoke snippet for ops (drop into OP-8222):
```bash
# orthomed-smoke.sh - kv warm + small hit
python tools/smoke_load.py --model orthomed-prod --rps 60 --duration 600 --kv-prefill 1
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preheat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"orthomed-prod","kv":true}'
```

zoe_sec: Also request: encryption-in-transit confirmation (TLS1.2+), KMS envelope workflow doc, and proof of SOC2 + recent pen-test PDF. I'll attach answers and ping Legal for BAA.

alesha_sales: Next steps: I'll put 8x reserved + 5x burst in the early SOW and include the cost ballpark and security notes. Pricing team to prepare formal quote and finance to validate. Harper to attach OP-8222 runbook. Derek to add the autoscale JSON to the Dedicated config draft.

pricing_bot: Roger. I'll draft two SKU lines: (A) 12-mo reserved 8 GPUs + burst credits (5), compliance addon, 24/7 support; (B) on-demand comparison for the customer's finance team. ETA: EOD.

harper_sre: I'll scope the preheat steps and add explicit KV warm durations to OP-8222; will coordinate AZ placement and spot caps. Tagging @zoe_sec for final security sign-off once Legal confirms BAA.

alesha_sales: Thanks all. Scheduling a technical handoff with OrthoMed Thurs 10am PT to finalize pilot cadence and SOW. Closing thread for now. :rocket:
